description: This file defines a React component for the Elasticsearch settings in the Mattermost admin console, including configuration options, testing connection, and managing Elasticsearch index jobs.

classes.name: ElasticsearchSettings
classes.description: React component for managing Elasticsearch configuration in the admin console, including connection testing, index rebuilding, and search settings.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Converts component state into the admin config object for Elasticsearch settings.

methods.name: getStateFromConfig
methods.description: Initializes component state from the provided admin config object.

methods.name: handleSettingChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to individual settings, updating state and dependent flags.

methods.name: handleSaved
methods.description: Updates state after settings are saved, particularly the canPurgeAndIndex flag.

methods.name: canSave
methods.description: Returns whether the current settings can be saved.

methods.name: doTestConfig
methods.description: Performs a test connection to Elasticsearch and updates state based on success or failure.

methods.name: getExtraInfo
methods.description: Provides additional info about Elasticsearch jobs, such as progress and type.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title of the settings section.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders the full settings UI for Elasticsearch configuration.
